title: Window
description: The window module displays the title of the currently focused window in Umbriel.

placeholders.description: The current title of the focused window.
The current app ID of the focused window.
The stable ID of the focused window.
The name of the workspace containing the focused window.
The stable ID of the workspace containing the focused window.
The layout of the workspace containing the focused window.
The output containing the focused window.
The window's column in the scrolling layout, or -1 when it is floating or the layout has no columns.
The window's row in the scrolling layout, or -1 when it is floating or the layout has no columns.
The highest column index among the windows on the same workspace.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed. See FORMAT REPLACEMENTS.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

rewrite.label: Rewrite
rewrite.doc: Rules to rewrite the window title. See REWRITE RULES.
rewrite.description: Rules to rewrite the window title. See REWRITE RULES.

separate-outputs.label: Separate outputs
separate-outputs.doc: Show the last focused window of the bar's output instead of the globally focused window.
separate-outputs.description: Show the last focused window of the bar's output instead of the globally focused window.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: The maximum length in characters the module should display.
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.

show-empty.label: Show empty
show-empty.doc: When no window is focused (empty workspace or all windows closed), keep the module visible and render format with empty replacements and {column}, {row} and {max_col} set to -1. When false, the module is hidden while no window is focused.
show-empty.description: When no window is focused (empty workspace or all windows closed), keep the module visible and render format with empty replacements and {column}, {row} and {max_col} set to -1. When false, the module is hidden while no window is focused.
